study.question: Observation: baseline click AUC is 0.65554408. Blocking auxiliary item gradients reached 0.66016336 but damaged auxiliary AUCs; private auxiliary tables restored auxiliary learning with essentially unchanged click AUC (0.66016383). Earlier learned auxiliary/self residual transfers fell to 0.65925750/0.65882115, and category/brand sharing fell to 0.65924368: these unsuccessful trajectories caution against equating additional coupling with complementarity. Target-match evidence reached 0.66181049 versus availability-only 0.66029265; collapsing feedback identity retained 0.66172534. Event gating reached 0.66247703 versus unweighted-mean gating 0.66182183, while collapsed event feedback retained 0.66245460. Most recently, auxiliary donors scored 0.66256488 detached and 0.66262409 live; self donors scored 0.66267259 detached and 0.66268016 live. Thus the latest declared INFNet-inspired auxiliary-transfer use was executed but did not beat the matched self controls; it does not establish complementary task supervision. All are single-seed validation observations, not significance claims. The consequential uncertainty is whether task-specific event gates improve click through relative history weighting or through their induced absolute coefficient mass. Does click-only redistribution retain value when coefficient L1 mass is held at the ungated level, conditional on the successful auxiliary-task paths?
study.hypothesis: The small primary-owned event gate improves target-conditioned history allocation beyond changing coefficient amplitude. If so, a click-only gate normalized to preserve the inherited signed scores' absolute mass should outperform no click gate, and the full gate should outperform a score-weighted scalar-only gate. Auxiliary event gates remain unchanged so removing useful auxiliary learning is not a simultaneous treatment. This is an attribution hypothesis for an existing model; it neither assumes useful cross-task donor gradients nor claims a new normalization method. An alternative is that score-weighted amplitude or joint amplitude/allocation optimization explains the observed gain.

study.proposed_difference: Add primary_gate_component in {full,redistribute,scale,none}. In FP32 after masking let s be [B,L,T] signed selector coefficients, g the unchanged nonnegative gates, b=sum_L |s| and m=sum_L |s*g|. Compute full=s*g; redistribute=(s*g/m)*b with redistribute=s at m=0; scale=(s/b)*m with zero when b=0; none=s. Select the declared operator for click and full for each auxiliary task, then restore the inherited score dtype for pooling. Divisions use finite safe denominators without detach; normalize before multiplying by mass to avoid an unbounded gain ratio at zero-weight events. All arms compute all intermediates; no new parameters, randomness, losses or metadata. For positive masses, redistribution preserves coefficient L1 mass and scale preserves base coefficient proportions. At m=0, the routing factor is defined as identity and the mass factor as zero. This does not hold the pooled-vector norm fixed. Candidate defaults to redistribution-only; three standalone modules implement controls.
predictions: Predeclared directional mechanism predictions: click AUC(redistribute)>AUC(none) and AUC(full)>AUC(scale). Report actual margins; one fixed-seed ranking is provisional, with no significance or prevalidated effect-size threshold.

At a fixed state before BF16 rounding, sum abs(redistributed coefficients) equals b, sum abs(scaled coefficients) equals m, and full equals redistribution times m/b when b,m>0. Scale-only is a nonnegative scalar multiple of the ungated pooled vector. All auxiliary coefficients equal full in every cell.

Zero gate initialization gives the same initial coefficient function in all four cells up to FP32 normalization/BF16 rounding. Empty histories keep zero pooled vectors and zero additive history corrections. Masked history and current target action do not contribute.

Full-control host validation should reproduce incumbent click AUC 0.66268016 within execution variability; inference overhead versus the archived incumbent must be measured, even though all four new arms share the same extra mass computations.

Use pre-existing history bins empty, 1-16, 17-64, >64 as secondary diagnostics. Their known validation counts/positives/negatives are 6444/427/6017, 461684/28818/432866, 1001754/55298/946456, and 1401885/50957/1350928. falsifiers: If redistribution fails to improve over none and full fails to improve over scale, the claimed incremental allocation value is unsupported in this implementation/recipe. If scale alone recovers full, revise toward amplitude/calibration. A failed variant does not refute all event-routing designs.
If only full improves, neither allocation nor amplitude alone explains the outcome; retain an interaction explanation and test a further discriminating control only when justified.

If FP32 coefficient conservation, zero/empty histories, mask invariance, label-order handling, finite gradients or full shared-state equivalence fail host preflight, treat this as an implementation failure and preserve its charged cost; do not treat it as scientific counterevidence.

If full rerun variation is comparable to candidate/control margins, defer attribution and retain the existing incumbent pending allowed paired repetition. A same-seed rerun is an execution audit, not an independent random-initialization result.
